create_rollout_storage: create a RolloutStorage instance for storing rollout data in RL training with external memory support
insert_rollout_step: insert observations, actions, rewards, and masks into the rollout storage at the current step
compute_returns: compute GAE or Monte Carlo returns from stored rewards and value predictions
generate_mini_batches: generate mini-batches from stored rollout data for RL policy gradient training
create_external_memory: create an ExternalMemory buffer to store and manage observation features over time
